target: M/X-class flare occurrence in the 24-hour forecast window

Low.meaning: below the 2017 threshold maintaining at least 90% recall

High.meaning: at least 50% validation recall at the upper cutoff

selection_rule: 2017 threshold maximized 0.40*recall + 0.40*TSS + 0.20*precision; Low/Moderate cutoff is max threshold with recall >=0.90; Moderate/High is max threshold with recall >=0.50.
event_evaluation: No event onset/peak timestamps are present in the label table; hourly-window scores and 24h proximity clusters are not distinct flare-event scores.
test_policy: 2020-2024 test results were previously observed and are descriptive only; never used for tuning, calibration, or threshold selection.
